report.summary: 4 findings narrowed/confirmed; 2 need settling checks before delivery; critical egress bug confirmed; missing-module misinterpretation and decoy-first logic need audit; containment default unknown.
risks: If OllamaProvider.caps sets local=True, budget system ignores egress costs from warm_model HTTP requests, leading to unbilled costs.
If GateResult.containment defaults to None, incomplete gate results weaken audit trail.
Callers of spectral_evidence may misinterpret missing keys as 'not measured' instead of 'not in graph', causing incorrect downstream analysis.
check_anchoring returns 'anchored_on_decoy' without checking correct answer, potentially causing false positives.
todos: Audit all callers of spectral_evidence for missing key handling.
Find GateResult definition and check containment default.
Inspect check_anchoring logic for decoy-first return.
Check OllamaProvider.caps local flag and budget egress tracking.

items.title: Confirm OllamaProvider.caps.local and fix egress tracking if needed
items.why_now: Critical: if local=True, budget ignores egress costs for warm_model HTTP requests, causing unbilled costs and potential budget overrun. This blocks any deployment relying on cost tracking.

steps.do: Check OllamaProvider.caps to see if local=True. Inspect daedalus/council/session.py for budget egress logic.
steps.verified_by: grep -rn 'caps' daedalus/council/session.py and inspect OllamaProvider class for local flag.

steps.do: If local=True, change it to local=False or add dynamic host-based egress detection. Update budget system to charge egress for non-local hosts.
steps.verified_by: Test that warm_model call incurs egress cost in budget when host is not localhost.

items.assumption: OllamaProvider.caps exists and sets local=True; budget system is in session.py.

items.title: Find GateResult definition and enforce containment default
items.why_now: High: if containment defaults to None, manual construction paths may leave incomplete gate results, weakening audit trail. This affects data integrity.

steps.do: Find GateResult class definition in daedalus/spine/attempt.py and check default value of containment field.
steps.verified_by: grep -rn 'class GateResult' daedalus/spine/attempt.py and inspect containment field definition.

steps.do: If default is None, change it to a sentinel (e.g., UNKNOWN) or raise error if not set. Audit all instantiation sites to ensure containment is always provided.
steps.verified_by: Test that GateResult raises error if containment not set; grep all 'GateResult(' calls to verify containment is passed.

items.title: Audit spectral_evidence callers for missing key handling
items.why_now: Medium: callers may misinterpret missing modules as 'not measured' (None) rather than 'not in graph', leading to incorrect downstream analysis. Unblocks confidence in spectral evidence usage.

steps.verified_by: Output shows all callers; manually inspect each for .get() usage and handling of None.

steps.do: For each caller that uses .get() without default or does not check for key existence, add explicit check and raise/log warning.
steps.verified_by: Test that missing key raises appropriate error or returns sentinel.

items.assumption: spectral_evidence is a function or dict; callers are in daedalus/.

items.title: Fix check_anchoring to check correct answer before decoy
items.why_now: Medium: check_anchoring returns 'anchored_on_decoy' if decoy word is present, even if correct answer is also present, causing false positives. This undermines canary accuracy.

steps.do: Inspect check_anchoring in daedalus/council/canary.py and modify logic to check correct answer presence first.
steps.verified_by: grep -A 20 'def check_anchoring' daedalus/council/canary.py; update to return 'correct' if both present.

steps.do: Add unit test for case where both decoy and correct answer are present.
